text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — user testing flagged a weird gap: in compact modals our footer action buttons (Primary + Secondary) are getting clipped by the modal edge when `spacing.density.compact-1` is applied. Screenshot: https://figma.com/file/compact-modal-clip
Jin: I saw that too. The focus ring gets cut off which is a big a11y fail. We should never allow visible focus outlines to be clipped by container padding reductions.
Zoe: Proposal: keep visual padding for focus rings even when density tokens reduce content padding. Introduce a token `focus.pad` or `focus.safeInset` that adds an invisible buffer for outlines.
Raul: Also noticed toasts in the bottom-left are colliding with the mobile nav on small widths. Maybe flip toast anchor to bottom-center for mobile or add a `toast.safeAreaInset` token so they don't overlap nav.
Maya: Agree on both. For modals: preserve focus ring space, and for toasts: use safe-inset aware positioning. On iOS-like UIs the system nav can cover edge toasts.
Jin: Implementation notes: 1) add `spacing.density.compact-*` doc blurb that warns about focus clipping, 2) add `focus.safeInset` default 6px, 3) toast token `toast.safeInsetBottom` default 56px on mobile breakpoints.
Zoe: Minor copy/accessibility nit: change button label from "Save" to "Save changes" inside modals so the meaning is explicit for screen readers. Also make sure icon-only modal close buttons have aria-label="Close dialog".
Raul: Motion: when we add safeInset and adjust positions, ensure we avoid layout shifts — animate opacity/translateY only and respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Maya: I'll update the Figma tokens and modal examples with the focus-safe inset and mobile toast variant. Can someone open a small spec PR with token names and CSS examples?
Jin: I'll draft the PR: include CSS snippet for focus-safe inset and toast bottom safe area variable. ETA tomorrow morning.
design-bot: Created ticket #DES-8134 for token updates and #A11-821 for a11y QA (focus ring, toast safe-area). Preview deploy will be posted when PR lands. :rocket:
